[Max Hidalgo Nácher](https://www.google.com/search?kgmid=%2Fg%2F11f4qhpj96&q=Max+Hidalgo+N%C3%A1cher) is an Associate Professor of Literary Theory and Comparative Literature at the [Universitat de Barcelona](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVdaQDuJIMhmiUm6f50-63VriHt-zzO7B6MnwsyDKD8zl89Vn1LXq3M6kZgCpZKuq4EwlYSLEOujzX1KhwiEUa6pqC7SiNckBOe2InbMjwkryEY01YeQofn6zgecDRtK0nqWLMaTkw8cGTpP1t4w8Roux-2eM) (UB). He is an accomplished academic, researcher, and translator whose work focuses heavily on the history and circulation of literary theory, the poetics of modernity, and the writings of the Republican exile from the Spanish Civil War. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEB6zswFcoCzQzReJaBs-d8_Dsp6DkAmONcXSmtQBCStB-NKMYfbSJygxsa-uDlmqG6ZD114Z3TvYPpr1gShwJ3zSykQYhmi_wwOJDIO_OfuYuuKqYfc17k-56MuBk8qyP6wJ5KUKRY34QZMyLY7FioEAfJsgi5ojnOp1NV4VbbWjbgNuc4rsRXlXgLJjtN9PE2FI2HDHrqnY_83jE), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVdaQDuJIMhmiUm6f50-63VriHt-zzO7B6MnwsyDKD8zl89Vn1LXq3M6kZgCpZKuq4EwlYSLEOujzX1KhwiEUa6pqC7SiNckBOe2InbMjwkryEY01YeQofn6zgecDRtK0nqWLMaTkw8cGTpP1t4w8Roux-2eM), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESagHrOzAVP4F9nCZtcmH_ey9mG4m2b5qRo8NZJ2I7NH0zPcMmbk8_BKXqLkVYWgAvh6VjT-rpAnXvVXl27d9T0MxDWbFIJsY0cDaTmPok58i78U4thDxq7JeS_j6Y9Klz_HqfZfNPSCZeazE)]
Background and Education
Dr. Hidalgo Nácher built a highly interdisciplinary foundation before earning his doctorate:

* Undergraduate Studies:
 He earned a degree in Journalism from the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (2004) followed by a degree in Literary Theory and Comparative Literature from the UB (2006). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEB6zswFSHfeQu2acgovDQci-T-JKu2Td4gwor1ThOB57b-z3gZX3td0rZ3phKlFKh7oSTP1s4FPQxpnuxzJtyzm4CvCZEjHOQ9qDSIJk-otcY1MIbDOmGZhHYYw9DRZSRazZ0RBdrtRnOqZ05XAQV1y0dR5mH3AWcObJmOnJM16uk65oTQa5AarlHn_WWUFcY), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEB6zswFcoCzQzReJaBs-d8_Dsp6DkAmONcXSmtQBCStB-NKMYfbSJygxsa-uDlmqG6ZD114Z3TvYPpr1gShwJ3zSykQYhmi_wwOJDIO_OfuYuuKqYfc17k-56MuBk8qyP6wJ5KUKRY34QZMyLY7FioEAfJsgi5ojnOp1NV4VbbWjbgNuc4rsRXlXgLJjtN9PE2FI2HDHrqnY_83jE)]
* Master’s Degree: He completed his Master 2 at Université Paris VII (Denis Diderot) under the supervision of the renowned theorist Julia Kristeva. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEB6zswFcoCzQzReJaBs-d8_Dsp6DkAmONcXSmtQBCStB-NKMYfbSJygxsa-uDlmqG6ZD114Z3TvYPpr1gShwJ3zSykQYhmi_wwOJDIO_OfuYuuKqYfc17k-56MuBk8qyP6wJ5KUKRY34QZMyLY7FioEAfJsgi5ojnOp1NV4VbbWjbgNuc4rsRXlXgLJjtN9PE2FI2HDHrqnY_83jE)]
* Doctorate: In 2013, he completed his Ph.D. at the UB with a dissertation titled El problema de la escritura en el campo intelectual francés (1945-1975), supervised by Nora Catelli. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVdaQDuJIMhmiUm6f50-63VriHt-zzO7B6MnwsyDKD8zl89Vn1LXq3M6kZgCpZKuq4EwlYSLEOujzX1KhwiEUa6pqC7SiNckBOe2InbMjwkryEY01YeQofn6zgecDRtK0nqWLMaTkw8cGTpP1t4w8Roux-2eM), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEB6zswFcoCzQzReJaBs-d8_Dsp6DkAmONcXSmtQBCStB-NKMYfbSJygxsa-uDlmqG6ZD114Z3TvYPpr1gShwJ3zSykQYhmi_wwOJDIO_OfuYuuKqYfc17k-56MuBk8qyP6wJ5KUKRY34QZMyLY7FioEAfJsgi5ojnOp1NV4VbbWjbgNuc4rsRXlXgLJjtN9PE2FI2HDHrqnY_83jE)]

Academic and Research Career
He has served as a visiting researcher and fellow at several prestigious institutions worldwide, including [Harvard University](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEB6zswFcoCzQzReJaBs-d8_Dsp6DkAmONcXSmtQBCStB-NKMYfbSJygxsa-uDlmqG6ZD114Z3TvYPpr1gShwJ3zSykQYhmi_wwOJDIO_OfuYuuKqYfc17k-56MuBk8qyP6wJ5KUKRY34QZMyLY7FioEAfJsgi5ojnOp1NV4VbbWjbgNuc4rsRXlXgLJjtN9PE2FI2HDHrqnY_83jE) (2016), Yale University (where he was a CLAIS Fellow in 2022), the Universidade de São Paulo, and the École Normale Supérieure in Paris. He also co-directed the cultural and literary criticism journal Puentes de crítica literaria y cultural. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHrOzAV85CpdLKS2jKHhOFaaINQrkG_gdbH_I13mT6XK9TIHV7eyPl912Zvjaptt_muieAxK591Qo_NI4F42zv3qGfR84LJU5vYGldIcdAWwBH84OJ9VhERAOeSB1BS7yATzf9R3w), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVdaQDuJIMhmiUm6f50-63VriHt-zzO7B6MnwsyDKD8zl89Vn1LXq3M6kZgCpZKuq4EwlYSLEOujzX1KhwiEUa6pqC7SiNckBOe2InbMjwkryEY01YeQofn6zgecDRtK0nqWLMaTkw8cGTpP1t4w8Roux-2eM), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEB6zswFcoCzQzReJaBs-d8_Dsp6DkAmONcXSmtQBCStB-NKMYfbSJygxsa-uDlmqG6ZD114Z3TvYPpr1gShwJ3zSykQYhmi_wwOJDIO_OfuYuuKqYfc17k-56MuBk8qyP6wJ5KUKRY34QZMyLY7FioEAfJsgi5ojnOp1NV4VbbWjbgNuc4rsRXlXgLJjtN9PE2FI2HDHrqnY_83jE)]
Core Publications & Translations
His scholarship spans across European and Latin American literary networks. Key highlights include:

* Teoría en tránsito (2022): His notable book subtitled Arqueología de la crítica y la teoría literaria españolas de 1966 a la posdictadura, which traces the evolution of Spanish literary theory and criticism. [[1](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=bFjIOJwAAAAJ&hl=en), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESagHrOzAVP4F9nCZtcmH_ey9mG4m2b5qRo8NZJ2I7NH0zPcMmbk8_BKXqLkVYWgAvh6VjT-rpAnXvVXl27d9T0MxDWbFIJsY0cDaTmPok58i78U4thDxq7JeS_j6Y9Klz_HqfZfNPSCZeazE)]
* Brazilian Literature & Haroldo de Campos: He is an expert on the Brazilian concrete poet Haroldo de Campos, having spent extensive time researching his intellectual networks, library, and theory of translation-linked writing. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESagHrOzAVP4F9nCZtcmH_ey9mG4m2b5qRo8NZJ2I7NH0zPcMmbk8_BKXqLkVYWgAvh6VjT-rpAnXvVXl27d9T0MxDWbFIJsY0cDaTmPok58i78U4thDxq7JeS_j6Y9Klz_HqfZfNPSCZeazE), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVdaQDuJIMhmiUm6f50-63VriHt-zzO7B6MnwsyDKD8zl89Vn1LXq3M6kZgCpZKuq4EwlYSLEOujzX1KhwiEUa6pqC7SiNckBOe2InbMjwkryEY01YeQofn6zgecDRtK0nqWLMaTkw8cGTpP1t4w8Roux-2eM)]
* Translations: He has translated various poetic works into Spanish, including books by Pol Guasch, Anna Dodas, and Diana Junkes. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHrOzAVdaQDuJIMhmiUm6f50-63VriHt-zzO7B6MnwsyDKD8zl89Vn1LXq3M6kZgCpZKuq4EwlYSLEOujzX1KhwiEUa6pqC7SiNckBOe2InbMjwkryEY01YeQofn6zgecDRtK0nqWLMaTkw8cGTpP1t4w8Roux-2eM)]
